lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did you put some things in that burn barrel that night?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: What happened to Teresa's other personal effects? I mean ah a woman usually has a purse right? (Brendan nods “yes”) Tell us what happened ta that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: I don't know what happened to it.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: What happened ta her ah, her cell phone? (short pause) Don't try ta ta think of somethin' just.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did Steven did you see whether ah a cell phone of hers?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Do you know whether she had a camera?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did Steven tell ya what he did with those things?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: I need ya to tell us the truth.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: What did he do with her her possessions?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Brendan, it's OK to tell us OK. It's really important that you continue being honest with us. OK, don't start lying now. If you know what happened to a cell phone or a camera or her purse, you need to tell us. OK? (Brendan nods “yes”) The hard parts over. Do you know what happened ta those items?
